title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched, full text of v1. Design: one teaching building (THUAS, Delft campus), hourly whole-building kWh, Sep 2022 to Mar 2024. Forecast issued daily at 23:00 UTC for the next 24 h. Validation 90 days (4 Nov 2023 to 2 Feb 2024) selects settings; test is 57 days, 2 Feb to 30 Mar 2024, 1,368 hourly targets. 11 configurations on the same windows; local models refit daily on the last 8,760 h.

title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched. Inputs: 30 covariates for every covariate model (21 calendar and schedule, 7 weather from KNMI station observations, 2 load lags at 24 and 168 h). Weather is retrospective observation, not a forecast. XGBoost gets the same 30. TimesFM 3.0 settings chosen on validation from 64 combinations: context 8,760 h, symmetric averaging on, no positivity transform, median as point forecast.

title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched. Pooled test MAE in kWh (Table 6): TimesFM 3.0 with covariates 19.97, TimesFM 3.0 target-only 20.01, TimesFM 2.5 target-only 21.07, XGBoost 22.45, Prophet with regressors 24.91, ridge 27.18, weekly seasonal naive 35.27, daily naive 37.57. RMSE: 30.26, 32.45, 31.85, 31.11 for the first four. The text gives the reduction against weekly naive as 15.30 kWh or 43.4%.

title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched. Paired daily-MAE bootstrap over the 57 days, 10,000 resamples, 95% percentile intervals, not adjusted for multiple comparisons or day-to-day dependence (Table 7). TimesFM 3.0 with covariates minus XGBoost: -2.48 kWh, interval -5.140 to 0.132. Target-only minus XGBoost: -2.44, -5.825 to 1.342. With covariates minus target-only: -0.04, -2.735 to 2.090. All three include zero.

title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched. Day types: test has 34 workdays, 12 weekend days, 11 holidays. Workday MAE: TimesFM 3.0 target-only 16.65, with covariates 18.85, XGBoost 22.88. Non-workday MAE 24.98, 21.63, 21.81; non-workday RMSE 42.75, 35.63, 29.50 (XGBoost lowest). Holidays: covariates cut TimesFM 3.0 MAE from 34.40 to 24.76 and RMSE from 53.74 to 39.47; workday and weekend RMSE rise by 3.00 and 2.46.

title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
note: Fetched.
